name: Product & Project Management
description: Showcase for product and project managers: shipped work, the outcomes it produced and how it was delivered.

heroSuggestions.title: Product Manager
heroSuggestions.summary: Product manager who turns customer problems into shipped outcomes, aligning teams and stakeholders around clear goals and measurable results.

summary.hint: Describe the teams, goals and outcomes. Never include confidential roadmaps, customer data or figures you are not allowed to share.

category.hint: An area such as Growth or Platform. Used by the filter on the Shipped work page.

problem.hint: Never include confidential roadmaps, customer data or figures you are not allowed to share.

approach.hint: Never include confidential roadmaps, customer data or figures you are not allowed to share.

url.label: Link to the recording or slides
url.hint: http or https. Recordings are linked, not embedded.

heading.label: Home page hero
heading.hint: The headline block at the top of your home page. Plain text. Changes apply as soon as you save.

eyebrow.hint: A short line above the headline, such as your title and the products you work on. Plain text.

heading.label: Headline metrics
heading.hint: Numbers shown under the hero, such as adoption, revenue or cycle time. Only publish figures you can defend. Changes apply as soon as you save.

heading.label: Site sections
heading.hint: Choose which pages the site has, what the menu calls them and in which order. Hiding a page never deletes its content. Changes apply as soon as you save.

focus.label: Focus areas
focus.hint: One per line, for example the problems you are working on now.

heading.label: Backup and portability
heading.hint: Download all your content as one JSON file, or load one. You see a preview first; nothing is written until you confirm, and an import never deletes anything.

exportHeading.label: Export
exportHeading.hint: One JSON file with the profile and every entry, drafts included. Uploaded images are not in it, but the file lists the ones it uses.

importHeading.label: Import
importHeading.hint: Entries are matched to yours by name, address name or title: a match is updated, anything else is added.
